title: Observability weekly 2026-08-24
content:
Observability team weekly notes — week of 2026-08-24

Attendees:
- Asha Patel (owner)
- Jonas Rivera
- Maya Singh
- Priya Kumar (SRE)
- Owen Park (platform eng)

High-level goals this week:
- Finalize end-to-end tracing rollout for dedicated infra (canary + sampling adjustments).
- Ship dashboard refresh for cost telemetry (new per-model cost breakdown).
- Triage and close high-volume alert flaps in prod related to trace ingestion spikes.

Standup highlights / updates:
- Asha: landed schema changes to span tags to include low-cardinality service_version. Deployed to staging; need one more canary to verify UI sidebars render correctly. Blocker: frontend team reported a missing index on the tracing-search table, causing 10s query latencies in staging (see JIRA-OBS-458).
- Jonas: finished backend portion of per-model cost aggregation job. Running hourly job in dev; numbers align with sample telemetry for small customers. Next: add attribution to route tags and push to staging for QA.
- Maya: dashboard refresh PR open for review (https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/879). Working on unit tests for the cost rollup and UI filters. Need design help for the per-tenant compare view.
- Priya: investigated alert flaps on trace-ingester-prod-1 — root cause appears to be GC pauses on the ingest JVM when batch sizes spike. Throttling batch size reduces CPU but increases latency. Proposed mitigation: enable backpressure until the new batching config ships. Rolling this change to one AZ tomorrow.
- Owen: rolling update of tracing-worker autoscaling policy to add a short-term limit to avoid cascading scale-ups during noisy bursts. Will coordinate with Priya during rollout.

Incidents / Alerts:
- 2026-08-22 14:12 UTC: trace ingestion spike caused 5m of elevated error rate (5xx) on /ingest. Mitigated by manual throttle and scaling. Root cause: sudden burst of high-cardinality spans from internal alpha test harness. Action: add rate-limiter per-client and update docs for alpha team. (Owner: Priya)
- Ongoing: flapping alert OBS-ALERT-092 (trace-search latency > 2s) — suspected missing DB index on trace_search (see blocker above). Triage in progress. (Owner: Asha, linked JIRA-OBS-458)

Work items / TODOs:
- Asha: follow up with frontend on adding index, then re-run staging perf tests (due 2026-08-26).
- Jonas: instrument the cost aggregation job to emit sampling variance metric; create dashboard panel (due 2026-08-27).
- Maya: address design feedback on compare view and add integration tests (due 2026-08-28).
- Priya: rollout backpressure to ingesters in us-east-1 canary (tomorrow 2026-08-25) and monitor for regressions.
- Owen: finalize autoscaling policy changes and add e2e test to ensure no double-scale scenarios (due 2026-08-30).

Dashboards / Observability changes:
- Cost telemetry dashboard: new panels added
  - per-model token cost (hourly)
  - per-route latency vs cost scatterplot (early work)
  - top 20 customers by cost in last 7d
  - anomaly detector for sudden cost spikes (experimental)
  Note: dashboards are in the shared dashboard folder 'observability/cost-telemetry' in Grafana; Maya will sync with Design for UX polish.

Tracing updates:
- Sampling changes: default sample rate lowered to 0.2 for background jobs to reduce volume; increased to 1.0 for user-facing inference requests to preserve fidelity.
- Added new span attribute service_version to assist with rollbacks and rollout-driven regressions.
- Query performance: started experiment with a composite index on (trace_id, start_time) to speed up trace lookup; preliminary results show 60% reduction in median lookup time in staging.

Cost telemetry notes:
- Per-token cost attribution MVP is now calculating inferred GPU time + DB cost + network egress allocation. Current numbers look plausible but we need more validation against Dedicated billing (Jonas to run parity tests).
- Concern: sampling at 0.2 for background jobs may undercount cost on busy tenants that do many background tasks — will add a compensating estimator in next sprint.

Risks / Blockers:
- Missing DB index for trace search causing alerts and blocking tracing canary. (High priority)
- Alpha internal test harness continues to generate high-cardinality spans — need guardrails on client SDK to avoid accidental floods.
- Dashboard UX for cost compare blocked on design resource availability.

Decisions made:
- Move forward with per-client rate limiter in ingest pipeline as temporary protection against noisy clients.
- Keep sampling defaults as proposed; revisit after one week of production telemetry.

Meeting notes / action items for next sync (2026-08-31):
- Review production metrics for cost telemetry panel and adjust aggregation windows if noisy.
- Confirm index rollout status and verify trace-search alert quiet.
- Validate canary for backpressure change and autoscaling policy change (Priya + Owen).

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider an adaptive sampling policy driven by per-tenant volume and error rates (sketch in confluence: CONFLUENCE-OBS-231).
- Explore adding lightweight per-request cost tags at SDK level so cost attribution is more deterministic for customer-billed features.

Attached links / references:
- JIRA-OBS-458 (trace-search index)
- CONFLUENCE-OBS-231 (adaptive sampling notes)
- github.com/redwood/observability/pull/879 (dashboard PR)

End of notes.
